verdict.rationale: ROCm's own GPU specifications table lists the MI325X with the LLVM compile target gfx942 (CDNA3). ROCm provides the HIP runtime, compilers and libraries optimized for Instinct devices, and AMD publishes an MI325X-specific system acceptance guide, so the part is documented as a ROCm/HIP target. The community post questioning whether the software stack works in practice is general skepticism, not a concrete failure, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: an explicit entry in a ROCm supported-GPU/compatibility matrix in the evidence, and independent hands-on reports of compiling and running HIP workloads on MI325X.
